faq.question: What is EnglishAI?
faq.answer: EnglishAI is built for Uzbek speakers who have studied English but want more speaking practice. An AI tutor and six connected skills — Vocabulary, Grammar, Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening — help you use what you learn.

faq.question: Can I start for free?
faq.answer: Yes. The level test and introductory activities are free. Premium provides access to more learning content; check the current plan for features and limits.

faq.question: How does the platform work?
faq.answer: Find your level, choose a topic and practise it across six connected skills. Speak with the AI tutor, get feedback and revisit vocabulary with 3-, 7- and 21-day reviews.

faq.question: Which levels are supported?
faq.answer: From beginner A1 to advanced C2. The level check helps you find a starting point, and the learning path grows with you.

faq.question: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.answer: Yes. You can use EnglishAI in your browser or download the Android APK. Speaking exercises work with your phone’s microphone.

faq.question: How do Premium plans work?
faq.answer: Check the pricing page or the current in-app offer for available plans, payment methods and limits before subscribing.
